status.en: 94 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 22% fewer than the week before, most of them in Islamabad, Peshawar and Kabul.
status.nb: 94 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 22 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Islamabad, Peshawar og Kabul.

summary.en: Cross-border operations continued with security forces killing infiltrators in Upper Kurram and arresting Afghan Taliban members in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, while a bomb disposal official was killed by an IED in Upper South Waziristan. A high-voltage cable fell on a house in Bahawalnagar, killing three members of the same family, and a bus-truck collision on the Hazara Motorway killed eight and injured thirty. A strike on Iran’s nuclear facilities was discussed for its possible impact on Pakistan, and Iran’s Hormuz agreement with Pakistan faces a test after an LNG tanker attack. The conflict still accounts for 1,794 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Grenseoverskridende operasjoner fortsatte med at sikkerhetsstyrker drepte infiltranter i Upper Kurram og arresterte afghanske Taliban-medlemmer i Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, mens en bombefjerningsansatt ble drept av en IED i Upper South Waziristan. En høyspenningskabel falt på et hus i Bahawalnagar, og tre medlemmer av samme familie ble drept, og en kollisjon mellom buss og lastebil på Hazara-motorveien drepte åtte og såret tretti. Et angrep på Irans atomfasiliteter ble diskutert for sin mulige påvirkning på Pakistan, og Irans Hormuz-avtale med Pakistan står overfor en prøve etter et LNG-tankskipangrep. Konflikten står fortsatt for 1 794 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
